whyDiscarded: steps 3-6 failed for the harness's reason: before the first aim the camera's look was already at the pitch limit (shots-run1/3-selection.png looks straight down at the grass from (0, 84, 0)), so every look correction the aim loop computed needed more mouse travel than the viewport allows; the loop then only recentred the pointer (560 lock releases and re-takes, every one granted) and never moved, so neither corner was aimed (the corners fell back to __wiTest.select) and the paste ghost followed the aim straight down onto the camera's own column. RMB there was refused by the app's body check (D13 'you are inside it': the box (-1, 83, -3) … (1, 85, 0) holds the camera at (0, 84, 0)), which is the spec's behaviour, so the paste, the move, the cut, their undo and redo and the paste after the reload had nothing to check. What turned the look down before the first aim was not identified; two diagnostic runs afterwards (a look probe: 20 px of locked mouse move = 3.0-3.15° of yaw or pitch, i.e. the default 0.15°/px; and a traced aim at corner 1, which converged in 2 moves) did not reproduce it. The aim loop now clamps each move to the room the viewport leaves and recentres only at its edge, the step records the pose right after the lock and the probe, and the paste box is checked to be clear of the camera.

the label checks expected 'Paste 3 × 3 × 4' and 'Move 3 × 3 × 4' (the turned sizes); the page writes the clipboard's sizes with 'turned 90°' (D11's template 'Paste W × H × D · turned 90° · …'), so the check now reads the label's form and records its text (see observations).
